summary: Gottlieb's Q*bert is a golden-age arcade action-puzzle game, preserved through original cabinet/MAME-class routes and later licensed rereleases such as Q*bert Rebooted.

entries.title: Q*bert
entries.definitive_edition: Original Gottlieb arcade version, via cabinet or documented MAME-class emulation

emulation.notes: Document ROM set and diagonal input mapping carefully.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original arcade cabinet with correct diagonal joystick and operator settings

primary.why: The original arcade game is the fidelity target because later home ports and Q*bert Rebooted differ in controls, presentation, and included modes. Use a documented arcade/MAME route unless an owned cabinet is available.
primary.how_to_play: Use original arcade hardware or a documented MAME/Internet Arcade route. Record ROM set, emulator/version, input mapping/diagonal joystick handling, cabinet/control setup, lives/difficulty/operator settings, level, score, and whether Rebooted or home ports were excluded.

secondary.exclusive_content: Licensed rereleases, ports, and modern remake modes
secondary.what_to_play: Use only for access or version-history comparison.
secondary.why: They do not replace the arcade cabinet behavior.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Gottlieb cabinet route with diagonal joystick behavior.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Cabinet controls/operator settings and later port/remake behavior differ materially.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record ROM set, operator settings, joystick mapping, and whether Rebooted/home ports were used.
